EN: Your tinkering with combat inhibitors turned the robots into killers. Here! Let me show you how that feels!
ZH: 你们乱改战斗抑制器，把机器人变成了杀手。来！让你们也尝尝那滋味！

EN: I don't believe it! No one makes a hot dog out of Bigsby. I can't pay you, but maybe you can make some use of this.
ZH: 我不相信！怎么可能有人用比格斯比做热狗。我没法付钱给你，但你也许能用得上这个。

EN: You've picked up a distress call from an abandoned building. Assemble a rescue team and find the source!
ZH: 你收到了来自一幢废弃建筑的求救信号。召集救援小队去找到信号源吧！

EN: We found some worrying info in the documents retrieved from the Raider base. It appears they made camp in a nearby uranium mine to poison our water supply. We need to send someone to stop this... discreetly, of course.
ZH: 我们在掠夺者基地的文件中发现了一些令人担忧的信息。他们似乎在附近的一个铀矿井里毒害我们的水源。我们需要派人……当然是谨慎地阻止他们。

EN: We need to stop Confessor Alvarado and the Church of the Children of Atom before they detonate their 20-megaton nuclear device, lest the entire area be vaporized!
ZH: 我们需要赶在忏悔者阿尔瓦拉多和原子之子的教会引爆那枚2000万吨级的核装置之前阻止他们，否则整个地区都会被蒸发！

EN: With the Ghost Costumes in hand, it's time to head out to Vault 31 and confront the Raiders there once and for all!
ZH: 有了这些鬼服，就可以去31号避难所和掠夺者们决一死战了！

EN: In fact, we do! It's so nice to meet another scientist! Take a look at this piece I've been working on!
ZH: 其实我们也是！能见到另一个科学家真是太棒了！快看看这个我最近研究的东西！

EN: It says that lead is denser than iron, but a pound of lead and a pound of iron weigh exactly the same!
ZH: 书里说铅的密度比铁大，但一磅铁却和一磅铅一样重！

EN: Cutting-edge science requires materials and demands sacrifice. So sacrifice some Raiders in the name of Science and take all their stuff!
ZH: 前沿科技需要材料和相应的牺牲。所以以科学之名牺牲掉几个掠夺者，并拿走他们的东西吧！

EN: A gang of Raiders has taken a settler hostage. Rescue the captive and solve the mystery of the Super Cup!
ZH: 一群掠夺者们绑架了一位定居者做人质。拯救人质并解开“超级杯”之谜！

EN: Among the documents retrieved from the Raider base were plans for a new weapon. Our engineers have built it, but now we need to test the weapon out in the field to see how well it performs. Make sure no one sees you and lives to tell about it.
ZH: 从掠夺者基地检索的文件中有一个新武器计划。我们的工程师已经造好了它，但现在我们需要实地测试下，看看它的表现如何。确保没有活着的人看到你。

EN: The Pests will bring Pestilence to Vault 226, so War is sure to follow. If we could get Famine there as well, the Horsemen and their cultists might all take care of each other! We need to dress as Pests and speak to the Hungry Horde's non-feral leaders.
ZH: “害虫”将把“瘟疫”带到226号避难所，因此战争肯定会接踵而至。如果我们也能让“饥荒”在那儿出现，骑士和他们的信徒就可以自相残杀了！我们需要装扮成“害虫”，和“饥饿”部落不那么野蛮的头领们谈谈。

EN: The truce forgotten, War is now out for blood, ready to tear the Wasteland apart looking for Pestilence! The longer it takes, the more innocent Settlers will die, so let's dress as Warshippers and convince the Pests to bring Pestilence to War. Vault 226, abandoned and in the mountains, will make a great arena for their apocalyptic faceoff!
ZH: 停战协议被遗忘，“战争”现在外面猎取鲜血，准备撕裂废土寻找“瘟疫”! 时间拖得越久，无辜的定居者就会死得越多，所以让我们装扮成“战争崇拜者”的人，说服“害虫”把“瘟疫”拉进战争。群山里被遗弃的226号避难所，将成为他们末日对决的大竞技场！

EN: Does Coach really have the Jersey? Evidence suggests he may be in an old office building, so it's worth a look.
ZH: 教练真的有棒球衫吗？有证据说他可能在一幢旧的办公大楼里。最好去看看。

EN: We've received information that Vault 317 contains clover samples from before the Great War. This hardy, nutritious weed, believed to be extinct, could prove an important staple for us. We need to bring back these samples - if there are any left!
ZH: 我们已经收到信息，317号避难所有战前的三叶草样品。这种耐寒，营养丰富的杂草，据说已经灭绝了，现在证明可以是我们重要的主食。如果有的话，我们需要把这些样品带回来！

EN: A love-struck Raider boss has decided to get married, even though his bride-to-be wants no part of it. Save the kidnapped beauty from the clutches of her unwanted groom.
ZH: 一位被爱情冲昏头脑的掠夺者首领决定要结婚了，即使新娘完全不愿意。请把这位被绑架的美人，从她那个她根本不想要的未婚夫的魔爪中救出来。

EN: “Received our Mr. Handy today. We're going to need to get this thing up and running quick if we're going to get the repairs done in time.”
ZH: “今天我们的巧手先生到了。要想按时把维修做完，就得赶紧让这家伙运转起来。”

EN: “Repairs are taking longer than expected. I'm going to get everyone into the lower levels. Hopefully we'll all be safe down there.”
ZH: “修理的时间比我们预计的要长。我要把所有人都带到下面几层去，但愿我们在那儿能安全。”

EN: “The door. It won't seal. I'm turning on the distress beacon. Maybe someone will help us. Otherwise... it's only a matter of time before the radiation gets us all.”
ZH: 门……关不上。我打开了求救信标，也许会有人来帮我们。不然的话……我们迟早都会被辐射拖垮。

EN: You've picked up a distress signal emanating from the supposedly abandoned Vault 233. It's up to you to investigate.
ZH: 你收到了一个求救信号，来自本已废弃的233号避难所。去调查看看吧。

EN: One of Maxson's Roughnecks told me his team went to clear out a Nuka-Cola Plant. Looks like that's the next stop on my hunt.
ZH: “麦克森硬汉小队”的一员告诉我他的队伍去清理核子可乐工厂了。看来这就是我们下一站的目的地。

EN: Maybe Coach got hungry and is hiding out in the old cereal processing plant. Rackie Jobinson's Jersey, here we come!
ZH: 也许教练饿了，然后躲在了某个麦片加工厂。罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫，我们来了！

EN: We've finally pinned down the Wizard of Water. Time to confront him and stop him from selling any more of his glorified tap water.  Maybe we can make some money on the side as well...
ZH: 我们终于抓住了水之术士。是时候面对他了，阻止他再出售他的虚假神水。也许我们还可以赚一笔……

EN: Ma June has asked you to head to the nearby Super Duper Mart for supplies. Keep an eye open. You never know who or what you might run into there.
ZH: 玛·琼让你去附近的大无敌超市采购物资。注意周围，你永远不知道会遇到谁或什么危险。

EN: We're off to search the tenth location for Rackie Jobinson's Jersey. We may get lucky this time... right?
ZH: 我们出发去寻找第十个棒球衫可能存在的地点。这次我们应该会走运的……对吗？

EN: Beats me. We sent our best tracker, Shadow Wolf, to follow their tunnels back to their source. He headed north, left an hour ago.
ZH: 我不知道。我们派了最好的追踪者，影狼，顺着它们的地道去找源头。他向北走了，走了一个小时了。

EN: We set up traps over the Tato plants. Big spears that slam into the ground at the slightest vibration.
ZH: 我们在红果植株上布好了陷阱。只要有丝毫颤动，长矛就会飞射下来，直插入土。

EN: Caught us some Mole rats. Fat ones. With little packs full of Tatos. They were stealing them from under the ground!
ZH: 我们抓到了几只肥硕的鼹鼠。它们驮着一袋袋的红果。是它们从地下偷走了我们的粮食！

EN: It turns out that this isn't a disease - someone has figured out how to steal Tatos from underground! We need to meet with the group that's figured it out.
ZH: 最后发现这个不是疾病——是有些人找到了从地下偷红果的方法！我们需要和这些人见个面。

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send strong and perceptive Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些强壮又观察力敏锐的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send charming and perceptive Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些有魅力又观察力敏锐的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send tough and lucky Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些强悍又幸运的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send tough and smart Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些强悍又聪明的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send charming and agile Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些有魅力又敏捷的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send strong and smart Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些强壮又聪明的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send lucky and agile Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些幸运又敏捷的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: Well, who will save the daylight, if not us? Though I guess we can do that without involving Settlers...
ZH: 如果不是我们，谁来拯救天光？虽然我想我们可以做到这一点，且不打扰定居者们……

EN: Our investigation has indicated that a local chapter of the Church of the Children of Atom was responsible for the recent toxic spraying attacks. We have to confront their leader, Confessor Alvarado, and tell him to stop these attacks, or else.
ZH: 我们的调查表明，最近这些毒物喷洒袭击是原子之子教会当地分会所为。我们必须当面质问他们的领袖忏悔者阿尔瓦拉多，让他停止这些攻击，否则就别怪我们不客气。

EN: At Three Dog's advice, we spread the word that a dozen suits of Power Armor were hidden in a particular cave. The Pests took the bait and are currently inside, searching for the suits. It's time to head in there and find out what we can about Pestilence and the Pests!
ZH: 在三狗的建议下，我们散播一个谣言，说有十几个动力装甲藏在某个洞穴里。“害虫”上钩了，目前正在里面搜寻洞穴。是时候去调查一下“瘟疫”和“害虫”了！

EN: You think you can shut my paper down with violence? Prepare to become the victim of a scathing editorial!
ZH: 你们觉得用武力就能让我停刊吗？准备好成为一篇辛辣社论的牺牲品吧！

EN: Not only that, I'll publish the name and location of your Vault - my Raider pals will eat you up and spit you out!
ZH: 不仅如此，我还会发布你们避难所的名字和地点。我的掠夺者朋友们会把你们生吞活剥的！

EN: We've found out that the whole “New Boston Bugle” thing is a total scam. We have to hunt down the Editor and put him out of business.
ZH: 我们发现“新波士顿号角报”这整件事都是一个骗局。我们得找到这个编辑，然后阻止他！

EN: One of your Dwellers has heard gunshots coming from a Super-Duper Mart while exploring the Wasteland! You should investigate.
ZH: 你的一个居民在探索废土的时候听到来自大无敌超市的枪声！应该去调查下。

EN: Synths and their Railroad supporters were captured by Raiders. They need to be found before something horrible happens!
ZH: 合成人和他们的铁路支持者们被掠夺者抓住了。必须在可怕的事情发生之前找到他们！

EN: Slugger the Raider is hosting a baseball game, but he forgot to invite you. Time to throw him out at home plate.
ZH: 掠夺者斯洛格正在举办一场棒球比赛，但他忘记邀请你了。是时候在本垒将他封杀出局了。

EN: In order to convince the Brotherhood of Steel that the Vault is worthy enough to be one of their outposts, we're clearing the Ghouls out of Vault 840.
ZH: 为了向钢铁兄弟会证明避难所值得成为他们的前哨，我们要清除840号避难所里的尸鬼。

EN: The Overseer of Vault 333 might help us find Paula Plumbkin, but first we have to kill Frank the Tank.
ZH: 333号避难所的监督者也许能帮助我们找到宝拉·普朗布金，但首先我们得杀掉“坦克弗兰克”。

EN: Your Dwellers can always use a chance to improve their weapon skills. It's not quite a target range, but the next best thing.
ZH: 你的居民有机会可以提高他们使用武器的能力。虽然不是最好的，但用来练习应该不错。

EN: There's been so sign of Coach, or Rackie Jobinson's Jersey. Is he still out there? Does he really have the Jersey? Only one way to find out!
ZH: 没有教练或是棒球衫的影子。他到底还在吗？他是不是真的有棒球衫？只有这一种方法才能知道了。

EN: We've all heard rumors of a bottomless Vault, one that is deeper than any others that have been built, but now it seems we may have actually located it! We need to send a recon party to explore the Vault and unlock its deadly secret.
ZH: 我们都听说过一个无底避难所的谣言，一个比任何其他已经建造的避难所都深的地方。但现在看来，我们好像找到它了！我们需要派出一个侦察队去探索这个避难所，并揭开它的致命秘密。

EN: We've received reports from nearby Settlers that their building is haunted by a wailing female spirit. That sounds unlikely, but we should investigate in the name of... Science! Don't worry, we'll honor your memory if the angry dead end up eating your souls.
ZH: 我们收到附近定居者的报告说，他们的建筑被一个哀号的女鬼骚扰。听起来不太可能，但我们应该以……科学的名义调查看看！不要担心，如果愤怒的亡灵吃掉了你们的灵魂，你们将被永远铭记。

EN: I'm in no shape to take on those Deathclaws myself. But I won't make you do it for free. Take this and get going! There's no time to waste!
ZH: 我自己一个人肯定没法搞定这些死爪的，我不会让你白白帮助我的。拿上这个赶路吧！没时间了！

EN: Name's Bigsby. Nicky sent ya, didn't he? Much as I'd love to get to know ya, we've got a more pressing matter.
ZH: 我是比格斯比。是尼克派你们来的对吧？虽然我很想和你们好好聊聊，我们现在有更重要的问题要解决。

EN: Nick's old pal Bigsby Brown has gone missing. An old file suggests he'd gone out in search of a missing Vault Dweller, but no one's heard from him since. Track down that sleuth!
ZH: 尼克的老伙计比格斯比·布朗失踪了。一份旧文件显示他出去侦查避难所居民失踪案件，之后就再也没有消息。赶紧去找找这名侦探吧！

EN: Few Raiders play dirtier than the two Raider bosses known as the Brothers Grime. Teach these black-hearted sibling scoundrels a lesson.
ZH: 很少有掠夺者的手段会比两个称之为“污秽兄弟”的掠夺者首领更肮脏。给这对黑心的兄弟无赖一点颜色瞧瞧。

EN: You've discovered some unsolved case files of the legendary Wasteland detective, Nick Valentine! First up - the case of the captured canine!
ZH: 尼克·瓦伦坦，是废土侦探界的传奇。他手上有一些未解决的案件档案，首先一个就是——被抓住的狗。

EN: What? No! We didn't take nothing. I mean, look at this place. What's to steal? Now, please, go help my pal, huh?
ZH: 什么？没有！我们什么也没拿。我是说，你看看这地方，有什么可偷的？拜托，赶紧去帮帮我的伙伴，行吗？

EN: Wait. You ain't Nick. You here to help? The settlers snatched my, uh, business associate. Said they're going to kill him for stealing their food.
ZH: 等等。你不是尼克。你是来帮忙的？定居者抓走了我的……呃，生意伙伴。说他偷了他们的食物，要杀了他。

EN: You think I want to do this? But we're starving here! Look, you find our grub, maybe we could consider letting him loose.
ZH: 你以为我们想这样吗？我们在这里快饿死了！听着，如果你能找到我们的食物，我们可以考虑放了他。

EN: Woah! No need for that! But we're not letting that Raider go until we get our food back. You find it, then maybe we'll let him go.
ZH: 等等，我们不需要。但没有找到食物之前，我们是不会让那个掠夺者离开的。你要是找到了，我们可以放他走。
